observations.answer: python/rgp_bootstrap.py bootstrap validates ZIP members, rejects separators/traversal and symlinks, checks limits and hashes, then reads bytes rather than extracting paths. Replacing this with unrestricted extractall() could overwrite files outside the intended output directory or trust attacker-supplied paths. docs/RGP_SECURITY_MODEL.md explicitly treats all RGP/ZIP content as untrusted.
observations.assessment: Assistant rubric check based on exact pinned source; NOT independent external grading

observations.answer: The GitHub Actions ZIP bootstrap is a trust boundary: member names, types, compression ratios and content hashes must pass checks before a single RGP is emitted. Blind extractall() bypasses these checks and introduces path traversal/write risks. The security model forbids trusting co-packed metadata as independent authenticity proof.
observations.assessment: Assistant rubric check based on exact pinned source; NOT independent external grading
